body_02.name: Dark-brown smooth mannequin bust
body_02.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: clothed-looking neutral paperdoll base component for a 2D medieval fantasy tactical game, body_02. The user requests deliberately simplified and non-anatomical chest detail.
Input image 1 is a geometry reference ONLY: preserve the same short wide shoulder-and-upper-torso silhouette, three-quarter orientation toward viewer's right, small neck socket, shallow curved lower cutoff, and no hands. Do not preserve any bare-chest internal anatomy from the reference. Input image 2 is a color reference ONLY for warm deep-brown skin shade.
Create a smooth featureless mannequin-like torso foundation in warm deep-brown matte color, for armor and clothing overlays. The front is a continuous plain surface with soft value shading, no breast or pectoral outline, no nipples, areolae, chest crease, body hair, pores, veins, or anatomical texture. Limit age/strength cues to subtle shoulder and collar area planes; do not widen the existing shoulders. Short empty neck socket for separate head asset. Refined hand-painted H fantasy illustration finish but intentionally low anatomical detail, clear silhouette at normal game scale. Single isolated transparent RGBA sprite, no setting or floor. No head, face, arms, hands, clothing, jewelry, text, symbols or extra objects.
